title: 'Masters of the Universe': Camila Mendes Saves Nicholas Galitzine's Life in New Footage
text:
The two stars joined director Travis Knight on the CinemaCon stage for Amazon MGM's feature take on the Mattel property.
“This is the sword of power — it’s ancient, mystical, very difficult to get through security,” Galitzine quipped to the crowd while holding a large sword. “I was told not to swing it, legally.”Mendes teased that the film includes “so many muscles — more muscles than is necessary.
” She added, “Strip all that away, and it’s about a kid that doesn’t feel that he’s enough.”The group then unveiled new footage from the film. The clip opens with Galitzine being teasingly called “Highlander” multiple times. Suddenly, he is confronted by Beast Man, leading Galitzine to ask, “What is going on?” Thankfully, Teela emerges out of nowhere to save the day. “Adam, is it really you? You don’t recognize me?” she asks. “Ready to go home?” The cast includes Morena Baccarin , James Purefoy , Alison Brie , Sasheer Zamata , Charlotte Riley , Jóhannes Haukur Jóhannesson , Sam C. Wilson , Jon Xue Zhang , Hafthor Bjornsson and Kojo Attah . Additionally,is finally set to hit the big screen with a script credited to Chris Butler, Aaron Nee, Adam Nee and David Callaham. Todd Black, Jason Blumenthal, Robbie Brenner and DeVon Franklin serve as producers. CinemaCon is the annual event for exhibitors and Hollywood studios that runs this year from April 13-16. It is the official convention of Cinema United..
